answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases therefore burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the prism deposit is held in the trellis escrow, the comet audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 27 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
